venues.name: D&C DC
venues.notes_summary: **DC — Monday 3/23.** Steady night with Cognac Masterclass / Happy Hour (event sales $3,000). Doors at 5pm with reservations and walk-ins from the start; rocky early without a host and with industry at happy hour; Leel helped seat until Sophia arrived at 6. A few service recovery moments handled by dropping cava and chips & dip. Skinny crew, strong communication. Comps incl. employee discount; $1,206 event/employee voids. Kitchen: 17.31% of sales. Glassware pulled for the next day's event welcome cocktail. MOD: Josh.

venues.name: D&C EV
venues.notes_summary: **EV — Monday 3/23.** Sleepy night; peak hours from ~8:30, then the room suddenly emptied at 10pm (everyone said they were headed to sleep); engaged Toronto bartenders and a couple on the aesthetics and ethics of girly drinks. Lack of a full food menu and large parties crimped sales: no check hit $200. No large parties, 7 solos, no investor cocktails. Comps $52.80 (investor, one snaquiri, one DNL). Top sellers: Core Slight, First Time Listener, Revenant. Door: colder, mellower Monday, briefly buzzing ~9pm; mainly reservations at open, bar filling by 7 with two 4 tops, 8pm wave of 3 and 4 tops; quiet at 10; guests brought by D&C fans; a London couple whose son made cocktails from the books during Covid; welcomed Koba, a bagpiper from Red Hot Chili Pipers, and Franky Marshall and friends. No no-shows. (Form typed '3//24'; actual service date Monday 3/23.)
